source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: James would reveal himself to Barbara by saying , " Hello , Barbara ...! " , to the delight of many audience members .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Much later , after a one - night stand with Darryl Crawford ( Rex Smith ) , Barbara was forced to admit that the baby that was conceived ( Jennifer , named after her mother ) was not Hal 's , and he divorced her .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: In the 1990s , however , Barbara and Hal were to be married two more times , though their happiness was never long - lived .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: For the better part of three decades , Barbara 's turbulent personal life has seldom strayed from center stage .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: If her aunt Kim can be said to be one of the great heroines of As the World Turns , Barbara is certainly one of its great anti-heroines : spoiled , selfish , at times cold and haughty , yet underneath it all a painfully wounded and vulnerable woman , and a deeply loyal and loving parent .

text: Hank was a masculine man who was introduced to the town before revealing his homosexuality .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Marland had a rule never to introduce new characters until he had been at a series for six months and knew the canvas , but many of the new characters that Marland introduced often became every bit as beloved as the old favorites .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Many of the stories during this period revolved around Lucinda Walsh ( Elizabeth Hubbard ; she had been created shortly before Marland arrived at ATWT ) , a tough - as - nails businesswoman whose tremendous confidence , savvy and success in the boardroom masked a deep pain and vulnerability over her failings as a mother and romantic partner .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Her adopted daughter Lily ( Martha Byrne ) became , in many respects , the emotional centerpiece of the program , as she entered into a series of star - crossed love affairs that took much precedence in the late 1980s and early 1990s .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Although Lily was raised rich , she 'd had quite a tough childhood , having seen at a young age Martin Guest , the man she 'd believed to be her father , commit suicide .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: One day , Lily was told that her close friend and by then brother - in - law Craig Montgomery 's airplane had gone down .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Thinking him dead , Lily ran to a barn at the Snyder Farm and wept .

text: Farmhand Rod Landry ( William Fichtner ) found her here and shook her , asking what was wrong .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: At this moment , Lily 's biological mother Iva Snyder ( Lisa Brown ) happened to enter the room .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: She thought that Rod ( whose real identity was Josh Snyder ) was trying to rape Lily as he 'd raped her , so she grabbed a pitchfork and blurted out that Lily was Rod / Josh 's daughter .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Emotionally charged scenes like these were characteristic of Marland 's tenure .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: One of the more puzzling aspects of the Snyder family involved near - incestuous relationships , the most confusing of which involved Lily and Holden ( Jon Hensley ) .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Lily was dating safe , kindhearted Dusty Donovan ( then played by Brian Bloom ) in 1985 when brooding stable boy Holden Snyder taught her how to ride horses .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Sensing a palpable chemistry between Byrne and Hensley , Marland paired them up .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: The problem was that if Iva was Holden 's sister and Lily was Iva 's daughter , then Holden was Lily 's biological uncle .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: To straighten out the mess , Marland had Iva learn she had been adopted by Emma ( Kathleen Widdoes ) and Henry Snyder at a time when they believed they could not conceive children .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Another , more controversial story aspect was Meg Snyder ( then played by Jennifer Ashe ) falling in love with Josh Snyder in spite of knowing he had raped her sister .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Marland revealed Josh had been brutally beaten by his father for years , but some fans still never warmed to the Meg / Josh relationship .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Another Snyder story involved real incest , when Angel Lange ( Alice Haining ) arrived in Oakdale .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: She had been Holden Snyder 's brother Caleb Snyder 's girlfriend while he lived in Chicago , and had an abortion .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: On the rebound and angry about Caleb 's shoddy treatment of Angel , Holden married Angel and they moved to Europe .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: When they returned a year or so later , Angel refused to give him a divorce even though everyone knew he was in love with Lily .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: What seemed to be selfishness was actually abject terror of what her father Henry Lange ( James Rebhorn ) would do to her if she were alone .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Sure enough , one night Henry crawled into Angel 's bed and raped her , as he had been doing ever since she was a little girl .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: When Caleb learned the fetus Angel had aborted was her own father 's , he confronted Henry , who then killed himself out of shame .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Caleb stood trial due to his unwillingness to expose Angel 's secrets to the world , but finally Angel took the witness stand and confessed her father 's brutality .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: A few years later , Angel married the eldest Snyder brother , Seth ( Steve Bassett ) and they moved to New York City in 1993 .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Marland often delved into realistic portrayals of controversial , socially relevant topics in his storylines .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: During his tenure , the citizens of Oakdale encountered AIDS , homosexuality , Native American land rights , incest , euthanasia , and menopause , in addition to the more typical soap opera tribulations .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Marland always centered his stories around beloved characters and steered away from preaching .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: As a result , viewers accepted the heavy emphasis on social issues .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: At their wedding reception , Margo pushed the face of resident bitch Emily Stewart ( whose machinations had broken up Tom and Margo to begin with ) into the wedding cake ( which had been made by Tom 's mother , Lisa ) .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: ( The writers had reportedly planned to have Emily turn out to be Wallace 's murderer , but were forced by producers to change things mid-storyline . )

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: As the World Turns and other soaps began a move toward satire .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: The show used this " pregnancy epidemic " as an excuse for what fans felt was a dip in quality .

text: As the World Turns was still honoring its veteran actors , but as the decade progressed , that spotlight has inarguably dimmed .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: On June 2 , 2000 , the show did a special episode commemorating the 40 years of work by Don Hastings ( Chris 's father , Bob Hughes ) and Eileen Fulton ( Lisa Miller Hughes Eldridge Colman McColl Mitchell Grimaldi ) on the show .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: In the episode , town - witch Emily Stewart published an article in her tabloid rag blasting the oft - married Lisa .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: A spontaneous party was thrown to support Lisa , and at the end of the episode , she and Bob shared a dance as they remembered old times .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: With three leading ladies on maternity leave , the slack was picked up by Martha Byrne , who had played Lily Snyder on and off since 1985 and now tackled a dual role .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: While walking at the Snyder pond one day , Lily found some old love letters made out to " Beloved " .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Lily found a picture of " Beloved " and was startled to find she looked exactly like her .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: When Lily posted the picture of " Beloved " on the Internet , she found out that somebody in Atlantic City had exactly the same picture .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Meanwhile , Lily was remodeling her home with the help of a mysterious Australian named Simon Frasier ( Paul Leyden ) .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Simon was after the " Rose of Sharon " , a priceless diamond that his family member had given to Beloved .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: When Lily went to Atlantic City ( where she met her doppelgänger , Rose D'Angelo ) , Simon followed .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Lily found the diamond that she had read about in the letters Simon 's grandfather had written to " Beloved " , and accidentally came to possess it .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Though fighting for her life while being chased by Simon and his insane sister Celia ( Fiona Hutchison ) , Lily had become friends with Rose and did n't want to lose the priceless heirloom .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: The psychotic Celia did n't want Simon to find the diamond , so she proceeded to leave them on a deserted island , while Rose , convinced by a cryptic phone message that Lily was not coming home , settled into the rich Lily 's life .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Rose gradually fell in love with Holden and Lily ( in a case of Stockholm syndrome ) with Simon .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Rose was discovered to have been Lily 's identical twin , as their mother ( Iva ) had been drugged during the birth .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: The two initially hated each other , but gradually formed a bond at Lucinda 's insistence .

text: Maura West returned to As the World Turns after a long maternity leave during the fall of 2000 , in a storyline penned by new writer Hogan Sheffer .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Sheffer had been brought in to clean up Leah Laiman 's storylines ( Lily and Simon 's months spent on the deserted island , among other stagnant plots ) that had been progressively upsetting the show 's fans .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: When West 's re-introduction ( which also brought in Hunt Block as Craig Montgomery , a popular character from the 1980s and early 1990s ) proved popular with fans , Sheffer was promoted to head writer .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: The Sheffer years

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: As the new head writer of As the World Turns , Sheffer quickly became a critical darling , although by the end of his five - year run as head writer he would be a controversial figure among As the World Turns fans .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: By some , he was credited with reviving the strong sense of character development and emotional complexity long associated with the program .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: By others , ( most vocally by five - decade veteran actress Eileen Fulton ) , he was accused of neglecting the show 's veteran characters .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: A major complaint from the latter group was lack of payoff and complete ignorance of the show 's history .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Although some of the As the World Turns audience became jaded with Sheffer during his tenure as head writer , he was initially almost universally beloved .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: ATWT 's success at the 2001 Daytime Emmy Award Show , after having been neglected for the better part of the 1990s , was credited to Sheffer , who had never held a position in daytime soap writing before As the World Turns .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Sheffer himself professed in one interview that he had never seen a soap opera before January 15 , 2000 ; when Procter & Gamble asked him to tune in to watch As the World Turns and Guiding Light and decide which one he wanted to write for .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Guiding Light , which revolved mostly around the government of fictitious tropical island San Cristobel and the Santos mafia family at the time , did not interest Sheffer very much .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: As the World Turns , however , intrigued Sheffer .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: He thought the storylines were " boring as hell " but liked the actors and characters .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Brutal honesty in interviews became Sheffer 's trademark .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: In the television industry , and soap operas especially , many interviews from network and sponsor executives came off as rehearsed .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Sheffer was always blunt , admitting to his faults and mistakes and not being afraid to curse .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: As pressure to court the audience of younger - skewing ABC Daytime increased , various former - ABC Daytime stars were hired by As the World Turns during the Sheffer Era.

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: By 2004 , it was felt by fans and executives that these stars were beginning to dominate the show and Sheffer started making efforts to include longtime actors such as Kathryn Hays , Don Hastings , and Helen Wagner back into the story ( although two other long - time actors , Benjamin Hendrickson and Larry Bryggman , who had a combined 54 years on As the World Turns , left the show that year in contract disputes . )

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Under Sheffer ,

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: As the World Turns secured Daytime Emmy awards for Outstanding Drama Series in 2001 and 2003 , and for Outstanding Drama Series Writing Team in 2001 , 2002 , and 2004 .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: The Sheffer Era can probably be split into pre- and post - summer 2001 , when Mary Alice Dwyer - Dobbin dictated changes in the writing staff .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Hal Corley , Stephen Demorest , and Richard J. Allen were fired from the writing staff and replaced by female writers , in an attempt to " soften " the program .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Sheffer was against this move , stating to the media that he was " surrounded by women " in the As the World Turns writing room .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Sheffer clearly loved adventure and mystery storylines , and under his tenure the program began to up its shock value quotient .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: The first of many mystery storylines under Sheffer culminated in early 2001 , when , following a long search , popular couple Jake and Molly McKinnon located Jake 's previously assumed - dead twin daughters , Bridget and Michelle .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Their happiness , however , would not last .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Molly 's ex-boyfriend , Nick Scudder ( Carl T. Evans ) , responsible for landing her in jail ( where she met Lily in 1997 ) , surfaced in Oakdale .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: He swore that he had reformed and took a job at Kim 's television station , WOAK - 9 . Molly 's daughter Abigail befriended him , but one night Nick tried to rape her .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Then the next morning Nick was discovered dead .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Abigail had no memories of the night and for months the wheels of a murder mystery turned until it was revealed that the nanny of Bridget and Michelle , Mary Mennihan ( aka Mary Dolan ) ( Marian Tomas Griffin ) , had been responsible for killing Nick .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Worried that Abigail was close to recalling the events of the night Nick was murdered , Mary decided to attack .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: When Abigail eluded her , Mary resorted to a plan B of taking Molly hostage and holding up the wealthy Jake for a sizeable ransom .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Deciding to take matters into his own hands , Jake made a bold move to rescue Molly .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: The showdown culminated in Mary falling to her death from a rooftop high above Oakdale , but before that , she was successful in fatally shooting Jake .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Jake 's daughters were taken away from Molly ( in guest appearances by Another World stars Anna Stuart and Ellen Wheeler , who was also a director of As the World Turns at the time ) and although she was promised visits with them , this angle was never explored , as Molly quickly moved on into a romance with returned character Mike Kasnoff ( now played by Mark Collier ) in July 2002 , only two months after Jake 's death .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: The most popular of Sheffer 's many murder mysteries was a series of murders at the Oakdale Memorial Hospital in early 2003 .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Former Dynasty star John James joined the cast as Dr. Susan Stewart 's ( Marie Masters ) new colleague and love interest , Dr. Rick Decker .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Not long after , hospital patients began to randomly die .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: This storyline brought the hospital , neglected for several years , back to the forefront .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: SORASed younger characters Katie , Chris ( at this time played by Bailey Chase ) , and Susan 's younger daughter , Alison ( at this time played by Jessica Dunphy ) all took jobs there , putting them into contact with some of the older characters .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Although the older characters were gradually phased out of the storyline , no major characters were killed , and the younger characters 's jobs at the hospital did n't last very long , the effort was applauded by fans , and the suspense was enough to keep them coming back for more .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: James 's performance was also lauded as Rick Decker gradually showcased his true colors as a psychotic killer .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: During Sheffer 's tenure ,

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: As the World Turns placed a renewed emphasis on romance .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Although the show was accused during this period of having too many " insta - couples " ( which in soap lingo means couples who are put together quickly , regardless of the chemistry between the actors ) , many popular couples developed during this period nonetheless .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: At the 2000 Halloween party ( the theme was Roaring Twenties , ) Katie ( Terri Colombino ) and Simon ( Paul Leyden ) , having been scorned by the objects of their affections ( married duo Holden and Lily , respectively , ) had a one night stand in the back of a car .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Katie became enamored with former gigolo Simon , and began pursuing him .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: When the INS came after Simon ( who was from Australia ) , Katie married him to keep him in the country .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Fans rooted for Katie as she schemed to make Simon love her , and the duo renewed its vows in Fall 2001 .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Unfortunately , the show seemed unable to figure out where to go with the couple , giving them abbreviated or confusing stories such as Simon 's evil doppelgänger Donovan menacing Katie , or Katie 's career - making , " Butt Buster " aerobic videos , or when psychotic Dahlia Ventura ( Colleen Dion ) befriended Katie and inexplicably convinced her Simon killed one of his previous wives , her sister , Monique Farrar ( actually , Dahlia killed her own sister ) .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: In 2003 , Simon left town due to Bartleby Shears 's threats on Katie 's life .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Bartleby ( Jonno Roberts ; Roberts would also play Bartleby 's twin , Mordecai Shears ) was a former con man with whom Simon worked back in Australia .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Bartleby came to Oakdale looking for Simon to do one more con .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Simon did n't want to do the con and he ended up killing Bartleby and leaving town .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Before he left Simon took all the money out of their bank accounts .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Katie went to work at Memorial as a nurse 's aid .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Katie was devastated and even as she attempted to move on with Mike ( now played by Mark Collier ) returned to convince her to move on with her life , but several months later , Katie inexplicably learned that Simon was behind the return of Mike 's old girlfriend Pilar Domingo ( played from 1996 to 1997 by Roselyn Sanchez and in 2004 by Daniella Alonzo ) .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: As the World Turns never gave any reasonable explanation for Simon 's sudden turn to the dark side and the moment was panned by many fans and critics .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Although Mike and Katie were a popular couple , they were broken up in favor of a romance between Mike and Jennifer Munson ( played as an adult from July 1999 to March 2002 by Kim Onasch and from July 2003 until the character 's on - screen death in July 2006 by Jennifer Ferrin ) , whose own romance with the theretofore unknown Stenbeck son , Jordan ( Chris Beteem ) was deep - sixed .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: The Mike / Jen romance paved the way for a romance between Katie and fan - favorite Henry Coleman ( Trent Dawson ) .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Henry , who had loved Katie from afar for years , suggested to her that they marry in an attempt to make Mike jealous and come back to her .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Katie agreed ; Henry , however , was sincere in his proposal and hoped against hope that Katie would fall just as much in love with him as he was with her .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: The two opened a gym together and , for a few months , managed to be happy , even consummating their relationship .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: By May 2005 , Henry had realized once and for all that Katie could only love Mike , and despite Katie 's pleas , ended their marriage .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Another popular couple created by Sheffer was Aaron Snyder ( Agim Kaba ) and Alison Stewart ( Jessica Dunphy ) .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Alison had a crush on Aaron immediately after he showed up in Oakdale in 2002 , and pulled many schemes to try to steal him from Craig Montgomery 's saccharine daughter Lucy ( then played by Peyton List ) .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Aaron stayed with Lucy ( and in one lambasted storyline in Fall 2002 , Aaron and Lucy ( along with Alison ) went on the run after Aaron was accused of arson , touring college campuses across the country and having college students urge Hal to " free the Oakdale Three " ) while Alison developed a relationship with Chris Hughes ( Bailey Chase ) ( now a doctor , after only two years of pre-med and medical school ! )

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: However , Aaron and Alison remained close friends , and when Alison became pregnant it seemed like she and Chris would get married ( she suffered a miscarriage soon after ) .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Alison moved in with Chris 's family and befriended his grandmother Nancy Hughes .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: In summer 2004 , the Oakdale characters engaged in a quest to find the " Keys to the Kingdom " , a scavenger hunt sponsored by Lucinda 's newspaper with a cash reward .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Aaron and Alison teamed up and quickly became best friends .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Soon , however , they realized their feelings went beyond friendship , and when Chris left town after cheating on Alison with her sister Emily , Aaron and Alison declared their love for one another .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Unfortunately , Aaron 's entire right side became paralyzed in a boxing accident shortly after this .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Alison 's wanted to help him , but Aaron insisted that he do everything for himself .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: The young love story was seen as refreshing by many fans .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: In 2005 , Agim Kaba chose to leave the show , and Aaron moved to Seattle to be with his terminally ill mother , Julie .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Alison stayed behind for a few months , but in July 2005 , she moved to Seattle to be with Aaron and said farewell to Oakdale and her family .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Lucy ( then played by Peyton List ) , meanwhile , began dating the much older Dusty ( who had been lovers with her Aunt Lily fifteen years earlier ) , a romance that was popular with a subset of viewers who dubbed them " Lusty " .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: The romance ended rather abruptly , with Lucy leaving Oakdale for college in January 2005 .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: This storyline was responsible for ( in the eyes of many viewers ) doing irreversible damage to Craig 's character .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Craig had often been scheming since returning to town in 2000 , but he was so opposed to Dusty and Lucy 's relationship that he paid a man to stalk her .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: The story included Craig causing the death of Sierra 's fiancée , and Craig killing the paid stalker in cold blood .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: He paid for none of these crimes , and in spite of a brief kidnapping of Lucy and stay in a monastery ( arranged by Sierra in an attempt to make him change his ways ) , he seemed to feel no remorse for what he had done .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Perhaps the signature couple of the 2000s was Carly Tenney and Jack Snyder .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Sheffer professed little interest in the couple for a number of years , attempting to pair Carly up with Craig Montgomery , and saddling Jack with Julia ( Annie Parisse ) , who had debuted as a heroine but under Sheffer 's tenure spiralled into madness .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Julia killed a horse and kidnapped Carly before being sent to the mental institution .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: The absolute nadir arrived during 2002 , when Barbara Ryan had James Stenbeck kidnap Carly , Emily Stewart and Rose to get them out of the lives of the men she loved .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Jack planned to go search for Carly but Julia broke out of the institution and held Jack prisoner .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: In the course of the storyline , Julia , desperate for a child , gave Jack Viagra so that he would be forced to have sex with her .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Many fans expected a serious discussion of male rape , but instead the whole thing was played for laughs , and immediately forgotten .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Carly then had a brief fling with old flame Mike and had to figure out if Jack or Mike was the father of her baby .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Julia returned with a baby ( J.J. ) she claimed was Jack 's , but paternity tests proved otherwise .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: In summer 2003 , Jack and Carly remarried , only to have Jack presumed dead and suffering from amnesia .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: He recovered with the help of a nurse named Julia Larrabee and her son J.J. Julia tried to hang on to Jack post-amnesia and then seduced his cousin Holden .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: No explanation was ever given for the similarity in names .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: The nurse Julia was played by former ABC Daytime star Sarah Brown .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: In March 2005 , Julia hit her head during a fight with Lily and died .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Lily , scared that she would be blamed for the accidental death of Julia , fled the scene of her crime ( her son Luke helping her conceal evidence of having been at the scene of the crime . )

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: It was thought that Julia 's brother Keith ( played by another ABC Daytime star , Kin Shriner ) killed Julia , but when suspicion shifted to Luke , Lily took the blame for Julia 's death .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Lily became involved with Keith even though she suspected he killed Julia .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: The killer was actually Julia 's ex-husband ( Michael Lowry ) .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Tamara Tunie was a popular figure as DA Jessica in the 1980s and early 1990s .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: She returned to the show in 1999 but only began to receive leading material again in 2001 .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Unfortunately , much of that material served to , in the eyes of many fans , destroy her very self - assured , independent character .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Jessica lost her job as district attorney to a sleazy lawyer named T. Marshall Travers ( Lamman Rucker ) .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: In spite of this , she jeopardized her relationship with moral doctor Ben Harris in order to begin a hot and heavy affair with Marshall .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: When Jessica and Ben broke up , Marshall briefly moved into her home and many thought

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: As the World Turns was going to begin a formal romance between the two .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Instead , Marshall raped Jessica while she was asleep and a " he said / she said " rape trial commenced .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: During the early 2000s , As the World Turns was praised for bringing African - American characters like Jessica , Marshall , Ben , Bonnie ( Napiera Danielle Groves ) , and Isaac ( Paul Taylor ) to the forefront .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: However , the newfound racial integration ended when Jessica 's daughter Bonnie accidentally pushed Marshall out a window .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Bonnie and Isaac promptly left the show ( leading Isaac to sell " Java Underground " , the hangout of the early - 2000s , to Dusty , Molly , and Craig , who renamed it " Metro " ( and who would later sell to Aaron and Alison ) , adopting Marshall 's biological daughter ( and chronic troublemaker ) Sarah .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Jessica reunited with Ben , leaving them the only two African - American leads left ( besides Walker Daniels Real Andrews , a doctor who helped treat Barbara when she had a bout with brain cancer in spring 2004 .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: When the briefly reformed Barbara returned to her evil ways , Walker left her — and Oakdale . )

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: In 2004 , Jessica and her best friend Margo Hughes fought over a sleazy football player - turned - sportcaster named Doc , in spite of both ladies ' traumatic experiences with adultery and with shady men .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Jessica had sex with Doc and had to figure out who the father of her child was .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Doc was intended to be a roguish type of character but was so loathed by viewers that he did not even last six months .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: The soap magazines dubbed the storyline " worst of the year " .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Despite her dalliance with Doc , Margo and Tom reunited .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Ben temporarily became addicted to pain killers , causing himself to be accused of causing Aaron 's paralysis ( since Aaron , injured in a boxing match , needed neurosurgery and only Ben was available . )

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Jessica had a miscarriage .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: All four characters then returned to the back burner , and Ben and Jessica seemed to vanish altogether for most of 2005 .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: The exits of Kaba , List and Dunphy moved the show to try to rebuild its teen scene .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Tom and Margo 's son Casey was recast for the third time in two years , and Barbara and Hal 's son Will was aged to 17 years old .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Will ( Jesse Soffer ) was very popular with fans , but Casey was not and was often written in a negative manner .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Two other characters , however , were brought on who did not achieve widespread popularity .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Rafael Ortega ( first AJ Lamas , then Michael Cardelle ) , Lucy 's best friend from Montega , and his younger sister Celia ( Alyssa Diaz ) appeared for the first time , and immediately dominated storylines .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Rafael was recast within three months of his first appearance and he quickly began trying to control his sister 's life .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Many fans considered the actors playing these new " Montegan transplants " to be amateurs and even the writing was also decried as being amateur .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: In one scene , Rafael , Casey , and Will all joined Celia in the girls ' bathroom ; another scene featured Celia trying out for a singing competition and facing criticism from a " mean " , Simon Cowell - like judge — the problem was that many fans agreed with his criticisms !

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: In June 2005 , Rafael was written out for good and more attention was paid to new teen arrival Gwen Norbeck ( Jennifer Landon ) .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: In August 2005 , Celia left Oakdale when her relatives asked her to come back to Montega and she accepted , saying farewell to some of her friends .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: While the hijinks at Oakdale Latin High School continued , Lucinda 's daughter Sierra ( now played by Mary Beth Evans ) became a regular on the show ( after making only sporadic appearances for most of the past few decades ) .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: She began working at Lucinda 's company , Worldwide , with Dusty Donovan ( who 'd dated her daughter Lucy before Lucy 's exit from the show to attend college . )

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: The two enjoyed a mild flirtation , while Sierra 's ex-husband Craig worked with Jennifer ( who started a fashion company , Street Jeans . )

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: For a time the show seemed to be pushing Dusty towards Lucy 's mother , Sierra , but then announced plans for a storyline with long - absent Snyder sister Meg ( now played by Marie Wilson ) .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: For reasons that were never adequately explained by the show , Street Jeans fell under the control of Jennifer 's evil mother Barbara .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Upset that her mother took credit for her first successful fashion show and feeling abandoned by boyfriend Mike , Jennifer got drunk and had sex with Craig ( the father of her former lover , Bryant ) .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Mike discovered this and forgave Jennifer , but she was not yet home free , as she soon discovered she was pregnant .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Perhaps the most notorious hire from ABC was longtime One Life to Live actor Roger Howarth .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Howarth was brought on as a recast for Paul Ryan .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Some hardcore , devoted fans convinced themselves that his over - the - top take on the character was much more appropriate than his predecessor Scott Holroyd 's subtle , layered , and charming performance , but many viewers felt that Howarth did not understand the Paul character and was simply playing him as he 'd played his role on One Life to Live .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: With Howarth 's hammy histrionics in full flame , Paul became a much less interesting , and severely damaged , character .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Paul was engaged to Lily 's twin sister Rose , who was torn between him and Dusty .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: On their wedding day , Paul verbally tore Rose to shreds at the altar .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Rose collapsed and later died ( Paul 's younger brother Will , feeling she had created problems in the Ryan family , had actually poisoned her mouthwash ) .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Lily plunged into depression and clung to Dusty , but the long - term story projections ( which involved a Lily / Dusty and Holden / Molly pairing ) were rejected by Procter & Gamble .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Paul then began a relationship with Rosanna ( Cady McClain ) , who was fresh off a divorce from Craig ( Hunt Block ) and then became involved with Jordan ( Chris Beetem ) , the father of her young adopted son , Cabot .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: The fast - track romance baffled many viewers , as Paul suddenly began to be " happy " and with Rosanna spent significant chunks of time talking about how wonderful their lives were and how fantastic everything was .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Cabot was presumed dead ; but was actually kidnapped by James Stenbeck ( back from the dead ... yet again ) .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: After a story involving a hypnotized and drugged Emily Stewart ( Paul 's mother Barbara did it , framing her other son Will , and then eventually Rosanna ) , Stenbeck told Rosanna he would kill Cabot if she did not dump Paul and join him overseas .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Rosanna did so and vanished for several months .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Craig was kidnapped by Barbara and sent to Hong Kong - there he ran into Rosanna , who was being held prisoner because she had refused to marry James .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: James then planned to push her out of an airplane , but Craig sneaked on board and stopped him .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: He nearly killed James , but Rosanna asked him not to .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Rosanna then decided to let Cabot find another home where he would not be under such stress .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: The Cabot storyline was viewed as a " black hole " by many fans , because so many characters who came into contact with the child ( Rosanna , Craig , Jordan ) were then quickly written out .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Paul , meanwhile , began to grow close to his long - ago love Emily ( when played by Andrew Kavovit and Melanie Smith during the late 1980s , Emily had deflowered a teenaged Paul ) .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: In July 2005 , Rosanna was rushed to the hospital after a car she was driving was spun out of control by an equally out of control Craig Montgomery .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Plunging into a coma , she was eventually sent to a hospital in Europe .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Craig was arrested for trying to kill Rosanna .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: And in August 2005 , Craig was sentenced to life in state prison after having committed numerous crimes .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: The show 's Emmy Award streak ( which had begun at the 2001 awards show ) came to an end in 2005 , when only 3 actors ( Howarth , Byrne , Jennifer Ferrin ) were nominated for awards .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: The show did win for Outstanding Writing , but Sheffer did not attend the ceremony .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Current head writer Jean Passanante accepted on his behalf and let viewers know that Sheffer was missed behind the scenes of As The World Turns .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Although As the World Turns had first been discussed online in the early 1990s by an eccentric group of posters on rec.arts .tv.soaps who came up with humorous names for the characters in their daily summaries ( e.g. Easy for Emily , Juicy for Lucinda , Holdumb for Holden , etc. ) , it was n't until the 2000s that As the World Turns began exploiting the internet for the first time .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: There were a few attempts at cross-promotion through the SoapCity website .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: During the 2001 season for example , viewers could read the Abigail character 's e-mails to her mother Molly , boyfriend Adam , and other friends .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: She discussed the events that took place on the show , offering the viewer another perspective .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: In 2003 , the show began repurposing itself daily through the SoapCity website for a small charge .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Although this service was discontinued in March 2005 , it was the first time As the World Turns had ever been repurposed .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: In early 2005 , it was announced that Hogan Sheffer would be taking a 17 - week sabbatical from his writing duties .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: On April 11 , 2005 , however , it was announced that Sheffer would not be returning to As the World Turns at all and was being replaced permanently in his duties by co-head writer Jean Passanante .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Although the last script credited to Sheffer aired on May 23 , 2005 , sources indicated that his work stopped airing at least a month before then .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Sheffer was asked to return to the show a few months later .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: He agreed to do so , but only on the condition that he be made a breakdown writer instead of the head writer .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: New beginnings

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: In mid-2005 , soon after the show celebrated its 49th year on television and began its 50th year , came news that As the World Turns and its sister show Guiding Light had been renewed by CBS through 2007 .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Both were required to make budget cuts , asking some of the higher - paid actors to take pay cuts .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Passanante , who was originally only intended to be a temporary head writer , found herself permanently in the head writer 's seat .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: She attempted to stay true to Sheffer 's vision for As the World Turns while mixing in her own unique style .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Leah Laiman and Christopher Whitesell served as her co-writers .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Lisa Connor , Paula Cwikly , Charlotte Gibson , Hogan Sheffer , Trent Jones and Frederick Johnson ( both ex The Young and the Restless , Emmy and WGA Award winners ) all served as associate head writers during 2005 .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Also As the World Turns audio podcasts of episodes released the day after the episodes aired on CBS were released on the iTunes Music Store .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Celia and Casey , who had originally received much focus , were given less airtime upon the hiring of Jennifer Landon as Gwen , a teenage girl pregnant with Casey 's child .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Will , not wanting Celia to be disappointed in Casey , claimed Gwen 's baby as his own .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Meanwhile , Mike waffled back and forth between Jennifer and Katie .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Jennifer and Dusty cooked up a scheme whereby Craig was forbidden from contact with his and Jen 's child for five years , and Mike 's discovery of this scheme landed him in bed with Katie .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Former All My Children , Port Charles and The Bold and the Beautiful star Brian Gaskill signed on to join the soap as B.J. Green ( aka Byron Glass ) , a high school classmate ( and obsessed admirer ) of Katie 's , leaving Mike and Katie in yet another love triangle .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: B.J. hired Katie and Mike at WOAK after being made Kim 's co-manager .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: He purchased Fairwinds and hosted a Halloween party there , revealing to Katie that he was actually the formerly obese high school nerd Byron .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: He continued stalking Katie through the end of 2005 .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: As Craig and Rosanna remarried and planned to adopt Gwen 's baby , Jennifer went into labor , and Craig toyed with the idea of switching the babies , which he proceeded to do .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: " Jennifer 's " baby ( which was actually Gwen 's baby ) died , and Jennifer went into hysterics — upon looking at the dead baby 's body , she remarked that it was not her child , but her family felt that her objectivity had been obscured and convinced her she was mistaken .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Craig attempted to comfort Jennifer , but his wife Rosanna realized that he was not nearly as sad as was characteristic for Craig , considering that the dead baby was supposedly his .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Meanwhile , while flipping through a family scrapbook , Carly came upon a picture of her father at Mabel 's Red Hots , a popular fast food restaurant in Oakdale .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Carly , not aware that her father had ever been to Oakdale , showed the picture to many longtime Oakdale residents , including Lisa , Nancy , Kim , and finally to Susan , who told her that the man in the picture had been involved in " something horrible " at a clinic which had closed .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Jack , wanting to get to the bottom of it , asked Jessica to open the file on the event .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Jack decided it was too horrible for Carly to ever know , but the determined Carly paid Henry to find the woman who was with her father in the picture .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: The woman ( Iris Dombrowski , played by Terri Garber ) revealed that Carly had done something to her son , and then began to blackmail Carly .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Rosanna found out Craig switched the babies , but before she could tell Paul , Craig ran her car off the road .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Rosanna was rendered comatose and Craig was shipped off to jail ( written off the show , his trial presumably happening off - camera , though none of the other characters , including his sisters Katie or Margo ever referred to it ) , which kicked off an umbrella story focused on the struggles of those most affected by the baby switch .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Carly and Gwen fought for custody of baby " Rory " , neither realizing that child died at birth .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: The child 's natural mother , Jennifer , was devastated by her loss .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Paul ( and soon Emily ) found out about the switch , but kept quiet because he wanted Jennifer to be free of Craig .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: During the custody hearing , Gwen was forced to reveal the name of her baby 's father .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: She told the truth ( Casey Hughes was the father ) but because of the baby switch , " Rory " 's DNA results did not match Casey 's , and everyone thought Gwen lied .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Gwen began to suspect Rory was not her real child .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Paul began to work to undermine his brother Will 's close friendship with Gwen , doing anything to keep Jennifer from her child .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: All the while Jennifer slid further and further into a crystal meth addiction , and Carly drugged Gwen to make her look like a bad mother .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Gwen then reconnected with her deadbeat mother , Iris , who unbeknownst to her was blackmailing Carly .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: As Gwen suffered more and more setbacks , she became one of the breakout stars of the show .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Paul had Jennifer committed after he realized she was on meth .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Dusty , who had a casual sexual relationship with a fixated Meg Snyder , became very protective of Jennifer , or " Jenny " as he called her .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Lucinda contracted breast cancer and struggled to deal with showing weakness to the outside world .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: She discovered that Lily 's boyfriend Keith smuggled human organs , and blackmailed him into helping her find experimental treatments for her cancer .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: The secrecy put a strain on Lily and Keith 's relationship , and drew her closer to Holden .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: The show remained in a consistent third place in the ratings for most of summer 2005 , as other , more established shows such as General Hospital at times went into freefall .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: In September 2005 Procter & Gamble announced their daytime division head , Mary Alice Dwyer - Dobbin was leaving and the position was being eliminated , which led some fans to doubt about whether or not they wanted to continue producing As the World Turns or Guiding Light .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Under Passanante 's ongoing tenure , the baby - switch story continued , with Carly finally realizing that she had not in fact killed Iris 's baby , after all ( Iris had orchestrated it to look that way ) , and that Iris had not even had a son but rather a daughter , who turned out to be Gwen ( this made Gwen and Carly half - sisters , a plot twist that was criticized by a number of fans , since it contradicted Carly 's age and history , in that she had to be rewritten as being eight to ten years younger to make the ages and dates correspond . )

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: As both women struggled to absorb the fact that they were half - sisters , custody of the baby was given to Gwen ( under the stipulation that she move back into her estranged , alcoholic mother 's house for " stability " ) , when it came out that Carly had drugged Gwen .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Meanwhile , Paul and Emily continued to work to keep Jennifer from learning the truth about the baby , going so far as to draw Meg ( who had put the pieces together on her own ) into their efforts .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Meg eventually could n't take the guilt and revealed to Dusty that she knew that Gwen 's child could n't possibly be hers .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Paul and Emily were caught trying to delete hospital records concerning the child , and the child was ordered to be returned to Jennifer within the night .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Gwen discovered that her baby had died and Casey finally apologized for not being there for her during her pregnancy .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: In October 2005 , Lucinda 's cancer had metastisized to the point where she was forced to undergo a mastectomy , while Luke became consumed by an infection he 'd picked up in Mexico ( when he 'd stowed away with his grandmother and Keith ) , which destroyed his kidneys .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Lily turned to Keith , who agreed to find Luke an illegally obtained kidney on the condition that she agree to marry him .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Lucinda and Holden soon discovered that Keith had obtained the kidney , but Lily feared that karma would allow something to happen to Luke if she went back on her word to Keith .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: She still could not deny her attraction to Holden , and after the two had sex , Keith finally left town .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Emily continued to stand by Paul after their role in keeping the baby switch was discovered , until Paul dumped her on their wedding day .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Emily then shot him .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: When B.J. Green tried to blow up the WOAK studios shortly before the new year , new character Nick Kasnoff ( who replaced Jack on the police force ) heroically stopped him .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Dusty dumped Meg Snyder on New Year 's Eve as they were about to get married because Dusty found out that Meg had a hand in covering up the baby swapping scheme by keeping silent that she knew that Jennifer was the mother .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: An injured Paul made it to a cabin out in the snowy woods , and Meg ( who had been fired from Memorial ) started taking care of him .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Paul started losing a lot of blood , and Meg tried to get him to rest but Paul was becoming delusional that Emily and his sister , Jennifer , were trying to kill him .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Susan became increasingly concerned for her daughter , Emily 's , mental health and asked Hal to investigate .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Hal put new cop , Nick , on the case .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Jack was rehired by Hal at the police part - time , and had trouble getting along with Nick .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Carly also had to contend with Nick 's flirtations , which she really did n't want .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Mike and Katie became engaged after Jennifer consented to a divorce , and they also forgave Maddie when she confessed that it was she who initially lured B.J. to Oakdale , not realizing how dangerous and unstable he really was .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Conditions improved slightly for Gwen , when Lisa offered her a room and a job at the Lakeview .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: ( Will went to stay with Bob and Kim . )

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Gwen 's good fortune was short - lived , however , as Barbara caused Lisa to think Gwen stole an expensive piece of jewellery from a hotel guest , resulting in her being fired .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: 2006 As February 2006 began , Will and Gwen were once again homeless and jobless .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Desperately , Will decided to steal a thousand dollars from Barbara 's Lakeview suite , and while Gwen tried to talk him out of it , she eventually agreed to the plan , going along with him .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: When Barbara turned out to be present in the suite , she threatened to call the police , and in his struggle to get the telephone away from his mother , Will pushed her , and she hit her head .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: When she regained consciousness in the hospital , she claimed it was Gwen , not Will who had intentionally pushed her , and that Will was not even present .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Will countered that it was he who had pushed his mother , but when Margo attempted to request the teens come into the station to be questioned , they fled , and a warrant was issued for their arrest .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Meanwhile , Luke sneaked out of the house to meet Kevin , but when he decided to return home shortly thereafter , he struck a girl with his car .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: She turned out to be okay , but revealed a startling fact to Luke , Lily and Holden : she was Rose 's daughter , Jade , who had been given up for adoption at birth .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Around this same time , Holden began to suspect that Luke might be gay and eventually Luke confirmed this when he came out to his parents .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Lily was shocked , as was Damien , who had returned to town in June 2006 .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Damien convinced Lily he would solve the " problem " with Luke and attempted to send him to a summer camp that advertised " gender re-alignment " .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Luke rebelled against his mother , hurt by her reaction to his revelation that he was gay .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Things were strained between them for quite a while and Luke eventually agreed to go to Krieger 's " summer camp " and went upstairs to pack his things .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Lily , discovering at the last minute that Damien had lied to her about the true purpose behind Krieger 's " de-gaying " camp and regretting her alignment with him , rushed home in an attempt to reconnect with Luke .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Still hurt and angry at his mother 's continual rejection , believing she alone was behind the idea to send him away , Luke pushed a pregnant Lily away from him causing her to fall down a long flight of stairs and lapse into a coma .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: In April 2006 , town matriarch Nancy Hughes McClosky was honored by the Women 's Guild for her fifty years of service .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Lisa , Lucinda , Kim , Barbara , Susan and Emma all joined Nancy at a luncheon honoring her , but on their way back , the bus they had chartered went off the road ( when Barbara , upset at having just learned of Paul and Emily 's marriage ) attempted to gain control of the steering wheel from the driver ) .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Though no one was seriously injured , the seven women were stranded in woods all night long .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: To pass the time , they reminisced about their lives and loves through the previous several decades .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: ( The special episode was written to commemorate ATWT 's fiftieth anniversary . )

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Emily , too , became pregnant during her short - lived sham marriage to Paul , and Paul convinced her not to have an abortion .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Emily did , however , use stem cells from her baby to help Johnny , Jennifer 's ill son .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Carly 's Alcoholism ( February 2009 - July 2009 )

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: After the stress of her divorce , Parker 's marriage and moving into the vodka business Carly began drinking .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Her drinking started to become obvious when Carly constantly became extremely drunk numerous times , flirting with strangers and also becoming abusive .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Carly then started to lie about her drinking and was drinking first thing in the morning .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Carly was then arrested for a DUI but that did not stop her as she then got extremely drunk and tried to kill Craig by running him down with her car .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: The toll the drinking was taking on Carly became more obvious as she was blacking out .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: She was also now becoming so drunk that she has verbally abused her young daughter Sage for not agreeing with her wedding to Craig and assaulted and kicked her sister Rosanna out of her house .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Her family held an intervention and Carly realized the toll her addiction was taking on herself and her family , so Craig checked her into rehab .

text: Noah 's Kidnapping ( April 2009 – May 2009 ) - Noah Mayer was kidnapped by the disgruntled daughter of a Grimaldi family member .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: He was held at ransom for the Grimaldi fortune which Luke Snyder inherited , believing she was the rightful recipient .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Luke was subsequently also kidnapped after falling into a trap trying to rescue Noah and Lily was held at gun point .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: Luke 's father Damien Grimaldi eventually rescued the boys but not before Noah had been shot and as the kidnapper Zoe Finn attempted to rape Luke in order to become pregnant with a legitimate Grimaldi heir .

source.page_title: History of As the World Turns

text: The two kidnappers were subsequently arrested after Casey notified Margo of their whereabouts after discovering a clue and Noah recovered from his gunshot wound .
